edits:
Use a genuine M28 control response only as an M32 initial-guess increment.

Both baseline fields must be completely accepted at the same physical metric,
material chart and exact raw mesh. This adapter preserves the complete accepted
M32 field and all 32 core parameters, then embeds a declared linear combination
of the saved M28 response vectors into the original cylindrical channels. New
M32 channels have zero *increment*, not zero baseline. The saved lower-resolution
response is never relabelled as an M32 Jacobian or an accepted new solution.

Only the initial guess is replaced. The corrected original frontload provider,
all-core plus three-geometry layout, inlet correction, original Newton/RMS,
true current-H full tail/Jacobian and final physical audit remain unchanged

ly accepted current M32 field plus an explicit old increment.

owns every change of mesh, parameter units and state increment. The old M28
response is never relabelled as a derivative at the current point. A fresh
grid retains all old comparison points, all current raw nodes, current
physical anchors and the current fixed-view quintic witness. No future
accepted primary or witness is fabricated. Geometry is only an unsolved
complete-mean warm diagnostic, with every original physical-domain gate.

Control arguments are increments from the current accepted point. If a
proposal was specified as a total increment from the old baseline, its
already implemented physical controls must first be subtracted explicitly.
No automatic inference of that subtraction is made by this entry
